item.title: Episode 4: Love, Marriage & Their Casual Relationship
item.description: When did marriage tie the knot with love? What impact did it have on queer love? What did marriage and love look like in Asia in premodern times? Surprising stories from across Asia.

item.title: Episode 5: Gods, Sex and the Patriarchy
item.description: A god of same-sex love. A bearded goddess of war and fertility. Gods in the form of genitalia. What can mythology and folk religion teach us about queerness in premodern Asia?

item.title: Episode 6: The West – Savior or Demonizer?
item.description: If queerness was so prevalent in premodern Asia, when and why did it all change? It starts with the 3Cs… Colonialism, Capitalism and Christianity. In part 1: the imposition of Christian moral…

item.title: Episode 7: Performing Gender (and Gender Bending Icons)
item.description: A god of same-sex love. A bearded goddess of war and fertility. Gods in the form of genitalia. What can mythology and folk religion teach us about queerness in premodern Asia?

item.title: Episode 8: For the Record…
item.description: Who gets to write history? What sources other than official archives are useful? Does P*rn count as history? What does it mean when something or someone is absent from the records?

item.title: Episode 9: In search of the “socially acceptable”
item.description: What is considered socially acceptable changes with the times. Hear surprising norms from premodern Asia that would seem very progressive today!
